recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build already implements the R5 clarification after later R6 SubscriptionTopic refactoring; any future uniqueness constraint or invariant should be raised as a new work-group decision based on implementer feedback.
issue_request: FHIR-39029 was a Published FHIR-core SubscriptionTopic change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked whether each SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape repetition identified a unique focus resource and whether notificationShape.resource should be unique, and also asked whether topics with multiple focus resources can describe what resource each eventTrigger/resourceTrigger produces. The approved resolution was to add clarifying text that multiple notificationShape elements can exist for the same resource to describe multiple possible groupings, and to clarify that triggers and shapes are linked based on the resource identified in each.
initial_application: The issue was applied by 338d001579be7486bb59bb0dd0c9c6da0b964caf, which added SubscriptionTopic narrative text saying multiple notificationShape elements can exist for the same resource and giving the Patient-with-Encounters versus Patient-with-Conditions example. Related FHIR-39030 commit e8b21b2071a6adc2c4cb2713bcb28808cd56ef12 clarified the trigger-resource-to-notification-shape relationship in the same source area.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 2023-01 minutes record the FHIR-39029 discussion as intentionally leaving notificationShape unconstrained until implementer feedback drives further constraints, then adding clarifying text with a 10-0-0 vote. Later FHIR-46492 collapsed resourceTrigger and eventTrigger into SubscriptionTopic.trigger and moved notificationShape under trigger, so the current model links triggers and shapes by containment and by trigger.resource/trigger.notificationShape.resource wording. FHIR-39030, FHIR-46492, and FHIR-47365 already have their own combined-branch reconcile commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-notes.xml already contains the multiple-shapes-for-the-same-resource clarification, and current source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml defines trigger.notificationShape as the shape generated by this trigger with trigger.notificationShape.resource tied to trigger.resource when present. Adding a uniqueness constraint would contradict the approved resolution.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the triggering-resource-to-notificationShape link in the same source area and is already represented on the combined branch by cffe444f5278eb843c26874e9ae5ca7c70cbe546.

Collapsed resourceTrigger/eventTrigger into trigger and moved notificationShape under trigger, preserving and strengthening the trigger-to-shape linkage; already represented on the combined branch by 39b57a2a7f3f814a1d11d55643869b1b223f6bf5.

Expanded SubscriptionTopic notes for non-FHIR notifications while retaining the FHIR-39029 notificationShape clarification; already represented on the combined branch by e759e4e7f8993d190df6ba58ac9a635ef3c60f0f.
